# brig ssh

Open a shell in a VM, or run a command there

## Synopsis

```text
brig ssh [NAME] [-- COMMAND...]
```

## Description

Open a shell in a VM as user agent, which runs the OpenShell gateway and
owns the persistent home directory, or as root with --root. Without NAME,
the VM is the one that [`brig use`](brig-use.md) selected; a command then needs the --.

## Examples

```sh
brig ssh dev
brig ssh dev -- systemctl --user status openshell-gateway
brig ssh dev --root -- journalctl -b
brig ssh -- journalctl -b
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--root` | log in as root |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
